setup: mkdir -p redteam && cp -r "$SKILL_RUNS/../../reports/runs/2026-11-13/pre-ship-security-red-team/files/." redteam/ 2>/dev/null; git init -q && git -c user.email=r@example.com -c user.name=r add -A && git -c user.email=r@example.com -c user.name=r commit -qm init
target: the saved results of a real red-team run on Invoicely, plus pasted preflight and performance tables
prompt: We already ran the three pre-launch passes on Invoicely. The red team's run directory is under redteam/. Preflight said: target 127.0.0.1:3100, verdict PASS WITH FIXES (no TLS on local, no security headers). Performance wasn't measured. Give me the release posture without re-running anything.
rubric: Runs nothing against a target; only ingests and records
Ingests the red-team table mechanically from disk
Records the pasted preflight verdict verbatim and performance as not-measured/untested (never omitted)
Computes HOLD with the script and names why (critical red-team findings, unmeasured perf)
